title: BTA! Blue Creepers
description: A Better Than Adventure! port of my Blue Creepers!
body:
This is a Better Than Adventure! port of my original Blue Creepers Resourcepack.
The name is fairly on the nose, as it retextures creepers to be Blue instead of green. 
Why retexture them? Because my partially colorblind butt is sick of not being able to see the things without cranking colorblind assistance to the max. 


For more info about Better Than Adventure, Check out their [Discord!](https://discord.com/invite/jvwD8BKq5e)
